entities.summary: Alexander George Goot is a singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist from New York City. As of 20 November 2025, his YouTube channel GootMusic has 3.83 million subscribers and more than 900 million total views. He plays acoustic guitar, bass guitar, piano, drums and other instruments.
